answer: Plume-Entropy Admission Gate: each agent’s identity slot is bound to a beacon value drawn after registration closes from a verifiable random function over a secret threshold key. The scheduler assigns slots only to identities whose derived key matches the revealed beacon prefix, so attackers cannot precompute favorable IDs. Mismatches forfeit the saffron deposit paid at submission, and each retry requires a fresh deposit, making n successful sybils cost roughly n times the base fee plus wasted submissions. Residual collision risk decays as the ember threshold rises,
